verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents an API to retrieve ThumbnailSet resources for a driveItem. It also claims rich thumbnails for hundreds of formats, so thumbnails can be fetched without rendering them yourself. Nothing in the evidence shows an embeddable document preview endpoint or iframe-style preview URL, so only the thumbnail half of the story is documented. Missing for 10: an embeddable document preview API, a list of supported formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of thumbnail generation.
